title: Chapter 69: First Encounter With The Wild Wolf Gang
content:
Chapter 69: First Encounter With The Wild Wolf Gang

Wang Shuo naturally didn't know about the bandit camp.

At this time, he was thinking by the fire, and Dongfang Ling came over.

"Hello, let's meet each other formally. My name is Dongfang Ling." Dongfang Ling said suddenly, which scared Wang Shuo.

Although both of them knew each other's name through reconnaissance skills.

But Wang Shuo still said politely: "Hello, my name is Wang Shuo."

"What's wrong with me?" Dongfang Ling deliberately teased Wang Shuo, biting her lips deliberately, showing a delicate expression, and said softly.

Wang Shuo was stunned for a moment, thought for a long time, and finally said tentatively: "You think it's a good idea?"

Dongfang Ling was speechless for a while, as if choked, as uncomfortable as eating rat shit.

There was no way to chat today.

Wang Shuo took the barbecue from Baili Liang and grilled the meat with him by the fire.

Before coming to this world, Baili Liang was a food lover. Because he loved to eat, he naturally learned a lot of cooking methods. Barbecue was his forte.

Soon, the mutton skewers exuded a meaty aroma. Wang Shuo took a bite and found them soft and refreshing, which made him very happy.

"Good craftsmanship!" Wang Shuo praised.

All the mutton was prepared by Baili Liang. Wang Shuo was only responsible for roasting it, so he did have some skills.

The meaty aroma quickly attracted the attention of others. Except for the patrolmen, everyone gathered around.

"Don't grab it, don't grab it, I still have a lot." Baili Liang was delighted to see everyone grabbing it.

Dongfang Ling said to Wang Shuo: "Give me a skewer."

"No."

Hey! I just want to ask if you are angry.

Just as everyone was enjoying the food, Li Weiguo ran over and reported to Wang Shuo: "Lord, we found a group of refugees in the distance."

"How many people are there and what is their level?" Wang Shuo put down the mutton skewers and looked into the night.

"There are 6 people on the other side, only 1 of them has reached level 12, and the others are less than level 10."

It seems that someone is leading the upgrade!

Wang Shuo didn't level up deliberately, so he didn't have any advantage in terms of level, and most players were higher than him.

The closer they got to Nanshanji, the fewer refugees would fight as soon as they met.

On the surface, the players were living in peace, but there were definitely fights behind the scenes.

"Be careful and ignore the other party if they don't get close." Wang Shuo just wanted to have a good rest now and didn't want to cause any trouble.

Now Wang Shuo's concept of catching refugees has also changed. If he had to catch them one by one, how long would it take to catch them?

It is the best policy to let these refugees go there voluntarily and join themselves.

First, their loyalty will be higher, and second, the population base will be larger.

Even if they are caught, they have to be caught in groups. Wang Shuo doesn't like such trivial things.

After eating two more skewers, Li Weiguo came back again.

"Lord, they want to come over and see you!"

Wang Shuo thought about it and agreed to their request.

Soon, a man named Fan Chengyang came over with three players.

Fan Chengyang was originally a member of the Wild Wolf Gang, which had not yet been established. As long as their prospective leader, Zhuge Kewei, issued a gang establishment order, they would become formal members.

At present, the Wild Wolf Gang already has more than 400 preparatory members, which is considered the largest force near Nanshanji.

With such a backer, he is very confident. The purpose of coming here is naturally to recruit Wang Shuo and others to join the gang.

Whoever recruits these new members into the gang will be in charge.

Now is the best time to expand the mountain. If he has a hundred or eighty people under his command, he can also be a hall master.

Therefore, he is very enthusiastic about recruiting new people into the gang.

But when he came to the campfire, he was a little lacking in confidence.

The players sitting here are well-equipped and well-trained, and there is one who has reached level 21, which is higher than the level of the Wild Wolf Gang leader.

He suddenly became a little nervous. It seems that he can't control this force.

"Sit down." Wang Shuo said casually.

Wang Shuo also asked Baili Liang to give some grilled lamb skewers to Fan Chengyang and others.

"Oh, good, good!" Fan Chengyang said a little flattered.

Under Ayub's terrifying aura, he instinctively seemed a little timid.

"You have been active in Nanshanji, right?" Wang Shuo took a bite of the lamb and said leisurely.

Fan Chengyang held the lamb skewers in his hand, not knowing whether to eat it!

Hearing Wang Shuo's question, he nodded and replied, "Yes."

"Tell me about the situation in Nanshanji!" Wang Shuo swallowed the lamb in his mouth, stared at Fan Chengyang, and his face showed a kind smile.

Although the temperature was not high at night, there were fine beads of sweat on his forehead at this time.

He regretted coming here a little. At this moment, it was like he was interrogating himself.

Of course, this was just an illusion caused by the unequal strength.

Wang Shuo did not mean to embarrass him.

It was just a friendly conversation.

"Don't be nervous. I came from far away. I'm new here and don't know the situation here." Wang Shuo saw his nervousness and comforted him.

"Pour some wine for them too."

Fan Chengyang took the wine bowl from Gong Zheng, took a sip, and then said: "After the fog dissipated, our shelter was near Nanshanji. The leader was kind-hearted and took us in. He was committed to building a strong gang so that we could live in this troubled time."

"Although our Wild Wolf Gang has not been officially established, the leader has already led the main force of the gang to kill the boss. I believe that the order to establish a gang will be issued soon."

"Brother, do you want to join our Wild Wolf Gang and seek common development together?"

Fan Chengyang's words were neither humble nor arrogant, and he was no longer nervous as before.

"What is the strength of your leader now?" Wang Shuo frowned and asked without thinking.

"Our leader is almost level 20 now." Fan Chengyang said with some pride.

The two asked and answered each other for half an hour.

Wang Shuo finally figured out the basic situation of Nanshanji.

Unexpectedly, these players established several forces so quickly, which made Wang Shuo a little amazed.

Is it better to establish a gang or a territory? Wang Shuo fell into deep thought.

Seeing that Wang Shuo had not spoken for a long time, Fan Chengyang said tentatively: "Brother Wang, our Wild Wolf Gang is currently the most powerful gang in this area. I believe that with your ability, you will soon become an important figure in the gang."

It is impossible to subdue Wang Shuo. If he can recommend an important member to join the gang, he will naturally be able to rise with the tide and gain a lot of benefits.

When Fan Chengyang thought of this, he tried his best to win over Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo came back to his senses and declined Fan Chengyang's invitation.

At this moment, a figure quickly approached.

Li Jianguo and his three brothers kept chasing behind.

"Stop quickly. You can't get close without the permission of the lord." Li Jianguo kept chasing the figure and kept shouting.

Obviously, the three brothers were unable to stop the man from approaching.

Wang Shuo looked up and saw that the man was tall and handsome, dressed in white, with a sword hanging from his waist, looking like a swordsman.

Wang Shuo was shocked when he saw his level, 25.

No wonder he didn't even wear armor.

Ayub stood up directly, holding the Qinglong sword in his hand, and Gong Zheng also raised a shield to protect Wang Shuo behind him.

The man came to the fire, ignored Wang Shuo and others, looked at Dongfang Ling, and said with relief: "Ling'er, I finally found you."

Dongfang Ling's face was a little ugly, pouting her little mouth, and said angrily: "Xie Fan, how did you find this place?"

Dongfang Ling's tone was a little unfriendly, and it was obvious that she didn't want to see this person.
